_doc: src/trustworthy_performance.py (Phase 2 part 11, P1_TRUSTWORTHY_PERFORMANCE). The owner sets every value in this file. The minimums below are COPIED from rules already in the repo (each `source` names it); none is new. Until the owner confirms them (`owner_confirmed`), the framework labels its output with that fact.
_clean_record_start_utc: View C (Clean Record) starts at the go-live merge of data-truth-100 to main (GitHub milestone 'Clean Record (2 months on repaired data)'). null = not live yet: every live tip is view A and view C is empty. The owner sets the UTC timestamp at go-live; it is never inferred.
_performance_claims_enabled: Owner rule: no new performance claims until the data is complete and he approves. While false the CLI only runs --dry-run (row counts per view); the full build needs this set to true by the owner.

settled.source: src/research/league_weekly_eval.py MIN_N = 30 (NOT_ENOUGH_DATA below 30 priced settled rows; the regime registry's adequacy bar)

matchdays.source: src/research/league_weekly_eval.py MIN_WEEKS = 8 (8 independent gameweeks). Here the unit is the match date, the block of the bootstrap; the owner confirms or changes the unit

clv.source: config/market_edge_v2.json strong_min_n = 150 (STRONG needs prospective CLV evidence, n >= 150) and src/nf_calibration.py MIN_N = 150
